key_insight: Conformal coverage can fail for time-dependent PDE surrogates because distributions at arbitrarily close times may be mutually singular.
engineering_relevance: Reliable uncertainty bounds for applications such as flood forecasting and thermal control require accounting for temporal distribution shifts and spatial grid resolution.
method: Analyze temporal distribution shifts in function spaces.
Study total variation distance under spatial discretization.
Use weighted conformal prediction for growing time horizons in certain settings.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results on mutual singularity, exponentially fast saturation of total variation with grid resolution, and finite-sample coverage in certain weighted-conformal settings; it specifies no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Weighted-conformal guarantees are setting-dependent, and spatial discretization may need restrictions to preserve coverage.
